items.title: After Indexing is Correct: Hash Join Spills, Splitting Joins Without N+1 & 4 UPSERT Traps
items.description: Advanced database query optimization when indexes are already optimal: Hash Join memory spills to disk, the art of application-side joins without N+1, deterministic SELECT-then-write ID ordering, and 4 dangerous traps of ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE.

items.title: Indexing & Query Optimization
items.description: Deep dive into database indexing mechanisms — covering disk I/O, B-Trees, hash indexes, composite index design, geospatial indexing, inverted indexes, EXPLAIN analysis, and Spring/JPA performance.

items.title: MySQL Indexing Vượt Qua Dấu Bằng: ORDER BY, Range Scans, ICP & Deferred Joins
items.description: Chi tiết cơ chế đánh index MySQL nâng cao: phân biệt Seek vs Filter, quy tắc Leftmost Prefix, ESR rule, Index Condition Pushdown (ICP), Skip Scan, và kỹ thuật Deferred Join tăng tốc 148 lần.
